items.text: Robots will take these jobs first. Is yours on the list?
which job will robot take first?
Well humanoid robot basically will have a penetration everywhere. Anywhere there is a human in the supply chain you can put a humanoid robot on it and voila, you will have a system which runs 24 -7.
But how does a company decide you want a robot?
Well, it depends on what kind of task you wanna do.
Robots can take job where things are repetitive, it is pattern -based,
But if you're in an industry which is art -based, for example, imagine a person who builds the value of a painting. How would AI know where the value comes from?
It's more like a human feeling. It comes from emotions.

A robot can't do that today. That it can't sit with us, have a sip, have some gossip while you're talking and then voila, this is what this human would like. That value is still there with the humans.
jewelers who take a diamond and knows which diamond goes well with what person, a robot can't take that, right?
the artistic touch stays with the human.
Which job do you think is safe from robots?
